title: ConfigFile
key_points: ConfigFile is a helper class to handle INI-style files.
It allows storing and retrieving Variant values on the filesystem using INI-style formatting.
Stored values are identified by a section and a key.
ConfigFile objects can be saved to or parsed from a file, or used directly in memory.
The class provides methods for manipulating stored data, such as set_value(), clear(), and erase_section().
limitations: Section and property names cannot contain spaces.
Comments starting with a semicolon (``;``) can be added to the file but will be ignored on load.
The file extension does not have any impact on its formatting or behavior.
asserts: ConfigFile is a suitable class for storing and retrieving INI-style formatted data on the filesystem.
scope: The context of ConfigFile is within the Godot engine, specifically in scenarios where INI-style formatted data needs to be stored and loaded from the filesystem.
